about: A wait by a real dealer of the style bordet (both hands lying still on the felt), lifted out of the live table's film by verktyg/lyft.py into the lens world of data/uppsattning.json. The same fields as the lifted deals, without a card. Both wrists are held 0.04 m over the felt. a is the face per frame: the shapes our own figure has, by ARKit's names, as MediaPipe's Face Landmarker scores them, 0 to 1 (null where the face was not found); evened over a tenth of a second, the blinks left as they are. Left and right are the dealer's own. It is the expression that is carried, not the face's form. data/stil-*.json, face, says which shapes carry something on a face this small and which are flutter.
hip_note: assumed: 0.47 m under the shoulders' middle; the hips are hidden behind the table
